Welcome to LingXi Mobile

LingXi is a remote control: all compute runs on your own computer, the phone only controls it.

Auto-scanning for LingXi engines on the same Wi-Fi…
Tap a result to connect.

Or tap "Change engine address" below:
· Choose "Official Hub" and sign in to control your home PC from anywhere
· Or enter an engine address manually

Pick a device to connect:

· 💻 LAN engine: direct connection, fastest
· 🌐 Official connect Hub: sign in with the same account as your PC; all your online engines are listed automatically and can be taken over from anywhere (the cloud only relays connections — no AI, no chat storage)

· Make sure the engine is running on your computer
· Or choose "Official connect Hub": sign in and control it remotely, no shared Wi-Fi needed
· You can also enter an address manually (public / Tailscale, etc.)
